Subject: Vendr onboarding: presign/S3 evidence + KMS proof clarification

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the quick portal invite. We started mapping the questionnaire items to our evidence catalog and hit two clarifications I hope you can confirm before we upload:

1) Presigned S3 proof: Vendr's template asks for a presign example demonstrating timestamped object access with role assertions. Do you accept a short preregistration artifact (presign URL + server logs showing the presign operation) or do you require a generated object with a documented TTL in the staging bucket? If the latter, please share the preferred bucket prefix and TTL policy.

2) KMS rotation evidence: the SIG question asks for documented KMS rotation procedure and a sample key rotation event. We can provide (a) a redacted CLI rotation audit + KMS key policy, or (b) a signed summary from our KMS provider showing rotation timestamps. Which format best aligns with Vendr's evidence ingestion?

I've attached a 1-page sample for the S3 presign (s3-presign-instructions.pdf) and a short KMS rotation summary for context.

Goal: we want to complete the portal upload in this sprint and avoid multiple back-and-forths if possible.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Security PM, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.example.com

---
Attachment stubs: s3-presign-instructions.pdf (1 page), kms-rotation-summary.txt (redacted)

Subject: Re: Vendr onboarding: presign/S3 evidence + KMS proof clarification

Hi Mina —

Great questions, thank you. Short answers below: 

1) Presigned S3 proof: We accept either a) a generated object in your staging bucket with a documented TTL and the presign URL (preferred), or b) a presign URL + server logs if you cannot create staging objects. For (a) please use the bucket prefix we provisioned: vendr-evidence/nimbus/ and set TTL = 24h. Include the object key and presign generation timestamp in the metadata.

2) KMS rotation evidence: option (a) — a redacted CLI rotation audit combined with the KMS key policy — is acceptable. Please ensure any key IDs are redacted and include the rotation event timestamp in ISO format.

We'll ingest artifacts via the portal attachment flow (one .zip containing the presigned object metadata and the redacted rotation audit). If you want, we can stage a short intake call Monday to walk through the upload and mapping.

Cheers,
Elena Rossi
Technical Onboarding, Vendr
elena.rossi@vendr.io

Onboarding intake: https://vendr.io/onboard/NIM-4821
